metadata.title: Existence of Lagrangian Mean Curvature Flow Singularities with Bounded Mean Curvature
metadata.abstract: In every dimension $n \ge 3$, we show there exist Lagrangian mean curvature flows that develop neck pinch singularities such that the mean curvature remains uniformly bounded. This follows from a related result that, under a structural assumption on the singularity formation, the mean curvature at small scales near the singularity can be bounded by the Lagrangian angle at outer scales with suitable weights. Applying this result to a subset of the finite-time Lagrangian mean curvature flow singularities constructed in the companion paper [ arXiv:2607.03152 ] and the infinite-time Lagrangian mean curvature flow singularities constructed by Tsai, Wood, and the second-named author [ arXiv:2401.02228 ] then gives examples of both finite-time and infinite-time singularity formation with uniformly bounded mean curvature.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在每个 n≥3 的维数给出平均曲率保持一致有界的拉格朗日平均曲率流颈缩奇异性。
techniques: Lawlor 颈内尺度与两平面锥中间尺度
古老热方程的 Liouville 定理
拉格朗日角加权估计及内点梯度界
analysis.breakthrough: 在内外尺度分离、内尺度极限为重数一 Lawlor 颈及中间尺度极限为横截两平面锥的假设下，将外环域拉格朗日角的加权界传至内部平均曲率。有限时 Cⁿ 颈缩与无限时平坦环面例分别满足这些条件。
analysis.limitations: 结构假设需要零 Maslov、适当浸入及所有相应序列的子列极限控制；有界平均曲率结论用于文中验证过的颈缩族。切流唯一性在导言仅作进一步路线讨论。补读所列定理，未核验伴随构造或整篇证明。
